root=Path("/home/qq/hia-native-integration-20261128-03da85-core")
out=root/"sha-scalar-cache-component-v1/interleaved-original-cache.json"

affinity=sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0));cpu=affinity[0];os.sched_setaffinity(0,{cpu})
maps=[];funcs={};pins={}
for name,path in paths.items():

for group in range(24):
 order=list(paths);rng.shuffle(order)
 for name in order:
  output=ctypes.create_string_buffer(b"\xa7"*32,32);workspace=ctypes.create_string_buffer(b"\xc3"*1184,1184);fn=funcs[name]
  f0=int(freq.read_text());t=time.monotonic_ns();c=time.process_time_ns()
  assert fn(init,1,output,32,workspace,1184)==0
  for _ in range(64):assert fn(block,65537,output,32,workspace,1184)==0

  assert output.raw==expected
  if state_ref is None:state_ref=workspace.raw

from pathlib import Path
import sys,subprocess,json,hashlib,mmap,ctypes,os,resource,struct,random,time
resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CORE,(0,0))
r=Path("/home/qq/hia-native-integration-20261128-03da85-core/source");sys.path.insert(0,str(r));o=r.parent/"sha-scalar-cache-component-v1"
pre=r.parent/"outer240-published-d547421e-v1/fresh/cold.native-cold/preseed"
assembly=pre/"bootstrap/hia-seed-assembly";projector=pre/"bootstrap/hia-seed-projector";backends={"old":pre/"products/seed-cold-endian-shift.tool","new":o/"candidate.backend-tool"}
from tools.generate_hia_cold_allocator_witness import document
from hepta.hia_agent_assembly import render_assembly
def invoke(exe,data,args=()):
 p=subprocess.run([str(exe),*args],input=data,capture_output=True,env={"PATH":"","LANG":"C"},timeout=30)
 assert p.returncode==0 and not p.stderr and p.stdout,(exe,p.returncode,p.stderr)
 return p.stdout
def call(raw):
 mm=mmap.mmap(-1,len(raw),prot=7);mm.write(raw);return ctypes.CFUNCTYPE(ctypes.c_uint64,ctypes.c_void_p,ctypes.c_uint64,ctypes.c_void_p,ctypes.c_uint64,ctypes.c_void_p,ctypes.c_uint64)(ctypes.addressof(ctypes.c_char.from_buffer(mm))),mm
rng=random.Random(0x7301);rows=[];fixtures=[]
entry="def entry(s:readbuf,o:mutbuf,w:mutbuf) -> u32:\n    value=widen(calculate(word_load(s,0),word_load(s,8),word_load(s,16),word_load(s,24)))\n"+"".join(f"    store(o,{i},(value >> {i*8}) & 255)\n" for i in range(8))+"    return 8\n"
for width in (8,16,32,64):
 source=entry+f"\ndef calculate(a:u{width},b:u{width},c:u{width},d:u{width}) -> u{width}:\n    x=a+b\n    y=x^b\n    return (y+c)>>d\n\ndef widen(value:u64) -> u64:\n    return value\n"
 raw=render_assembly(document(source)).encode();core=invoke(assembly,raw,("--agent-compact",));wire=invoke(projector,b"["+core+b',"f0",1]')
 begin=struct.unpack_from("<Q",wire,72)[0];a=struct.unpack_from("<8Q",wire,begin);b=struct.unpack_from("<8Q",wire,begin+64);assert a[:4]==(1,4,0,1) and b[:4]==(14,5,4,1),(a,b)
 # Reuse the old RHS slot as the first scalar's destination; the next
 # instruction reads that slot twice, so an unchanged cached RCX is stale.
 changed=bytearray(wire);struct.pack_into("<Q",changed,begin+8,1);struct.pack_into("<Q",changed,begin+64+16,1)
 fixtures.append((f"scalar_overwrites_cached_rhs_u{width}",bytes(changed)))
 # Also reuse the LHS slot; RAX must become the newly normalized result.
 changed=bytearray(wire);struct.pack_into("<Q",changed,begin+8,0);struct.pack_into("<Q",changed,begin+64+16,0)
 fixtures.append((f"scalar_overwrites_cached_lhs_u{width}",bytes(changed)))
wire=(o/"scalar64_constants.projected").read_bytes();begin=struct.unpack_from("<Q",wire,72)[0]
assert struct.unpack_from("<8Q",wire,begin)[:4]==(1,4,0,1)
assert struct.unpack_from("<8Q",wire,begin+64)[:3]==(32,5,3)
changed=bytearray(wire);struct.pack_into("<Q",changed,begin+64+8,4);struct.pack_into("<Q",changed,begin+128+24,4)
fixtures.append(("constant_overwrites_cached_lhs_u64",bytes(changed)))
for label,wire in fixtures:
 funcs={};maps=[];images={}
 for kind,exe in backends.items():
  flat=invoke(exe,wire);fn,mm=call(flat);funcs[kind]=fn;maps.append(mm);images[kind]={"bytes":len(flat),"sha256":hashlib.sha256(flat).hexdigest()}
 for ix in range(32):
  width=int(label.rsplit("u",1)[-1]);mask=(1<<width)-1;values=[rng.getrandbits(width),rng.getrandbits(width),rng.getrandbits(width),rng.randrange(width+2)]
  if ix==0:values=[mask,mask,mask,width-1]
  packet=ctypes.create_string_buffer(struct.pack("<4Q",*values));seen=[]
  for kind,fn in funcs.items():
   owner=mmap.mmap(-1,4096);owner.write(bytes((j*17+29)&255 for j in range(4096)));address=ctypes.addressof(ctypes.c_char.from_buffer(owner));pid=os.fork()
   if pid==0:
    if ctypes.CDLL(None).prctl(4,0,0,0,0)!=0:os._exit(125)
    result=fn(packet,32,address+64,64,address+1024,1024);struct.pack_into("<Q",owner,0,result);os._exit(0)
   _,status=os.waitpid(pid,0);seen.append((status,owner[:]));owner.close()
  assert seen[0]==seen[1],(label,ix,values,seen[0][0],seen[1][0])
  rows.append({"fixture":label,"case":ix,"input_sha256":hashlib.sha256(packet.raw).hexdigest(),"status":seen[0][0],"owner_sha256":hashlib.sha256(seen[0][1]).hexdigest()})
 (o/(label+".projected")).write_bytes(wire)
 for mm in maps:mm.close()
 print("SCALAR_CACHE_SLOT_REUSE_PASS",label,len(rows),json.dumps(images),flush=True)
report={"schema":"hia.cold.scalar-cache.slot-reuse.native.v1","passed":True,"scope":"actual accepted mutable-register IR; not full cold qualification","source_head":"d547421e89c9d08cd5a85630018750ced2b332e8","native_backend":{"bytes":(o/"candidate.backend-tool").stat().st_size,"sha256":hashlib.sha256((o/"candidate.backend-tool").read_bytes()).hexdigest()},"fixtures":[{"name":n,"bytes":len(v),"sha256":hashlib.sha256(v).hexdigest()} for n,v in fixtures],"pairs":rows}
(o/"slot-reuse-native.json").write_text(json.dumps(report,sort_keys=True,indent=2)+"\n")
